item.title: Building your first MCP server in ASP.NET Core
item.description: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) gives AI assistants a standardized way to interact with software. Learn how to construct your first MCP server in ASP.NET Core, expose C# tools using standard attributes, and test your setup end-to-end with the official MCP Inspector. Link to article: https://blog.elmah.io/building-your-first-mcp-server-in-asp-net-core/
